title: introduce-hook-capacity-profiles-and-onprem-image-prewarm
author: Aisha Khan
release_notes: Add values schema for per-hook capacity profiles; add optional on-prem image pre-warm DaemonSet and Helm helpers. Improves cold-starts for large model images and provides graceful shutdown ordering for init/postinstall hooks.
description:
Context and motivation:

Customers running Redwood Private on on-prem and air-gapped clusters reported long first-request latencies when nodes needed to pull large model images during upgrades or initial installs (ENG-2145). In addition, tenant-init and migration jobs sometimes compete for resources during upgrades, causing transient pod evictions and partial rollouts. This PR introduces two related improvements aimed at hardening installs and upgrades for private deployments: (1) per-hook capacity profiles (values schema + templating helpers) so chart consumers can declare concurrent worker limits and probe thresholds for init/hook pods, and (2) an optional on-prem image pre-warm DaemonSet that proactively pulls configured images before they are required by runtime pods.

Summary of changes:
- Add values.schema.json entries for .hookProfiles and .onPremPrewarm with validation and examples.
- New chart helper templates (templates/_hook-capacity.tpl, templates/_prewarm-helpers.tpl) to render resource and affinity overrides and a stable graceful-shutdown annotation consumed by hooks.
- Add templates/prewarm-daemonset.yaml: conditional DaemonSet that runs as a low-priority, node-local image puller and exposes metrics for progress. The DaemonSet is optional and disabled by default.
- Add templates/hook-postinstall-stager.yaml: lightweight PostInstall Job wrapper that respects capacity profile settings and emits a readiness marker to coordinate rollout waves.
- Update NOTES.txt to surface pre-warm status and next steps for operators.

Checklist:
- [x] values schema coverage for new keys
- [x] Unit tests for helper templates (helm template smoke)
- [x] Small integration smoke run in CI (helm template + kubeval)
- [x] Docs: add brief usage note to chart README (screenshot/examples deferred to follow-up)

Commits (high-level):
- a1b2c3d: add values.schema.json entries and README example for hookProfiles and onPremPrewarm
- d4e5f6g: implement prewarm DaemonSet template + RBAC and serviceaccount glue
- h7i8j9k: add helper templates and postinstall stager job; update NOTES and tests

Files changed (high level):
- values.schema.json (modified) -- add validation blocks for .hookProfiles and .onPremPrewarm
- values.yaml (modified) -- default disabled onPremPrewarm: {enabled: false, images: []}, example hookProfiles for tenant-init and migrate hooks
- templates/_hook-capacity.tpl (new) -- exposes tpl functions: hookCapacity, hookGracefulShutdownAnnotation
- templates/_prewarm-helpers.tpl (new) -- prewarmImageList, prewarmRBACName helpers
- templates/prewarm-daemonset.yaml (new) -- conditional DaemonSet with tolerations, low-priority class, pull policy configurable
- templates/hook-postinstall-stager.yaml (new) -- uses capacity profile to limit parallelism and writes a .ready marker ConfigMap
- NOTES.txt (modified) -- adds prewarm status pointers

Diff snippets (illustrative):
- values.schema.json: +"hookProfiles": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": { "type": "object", "properties": { "concurrency": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 1 }, "cpu": { "type": "string" }, "memory": { "type": "string" } } } }
- templates/prewarm-daemonset.yaml (templated conditional): +"{{- if .Values.onPremPrewarm.enabled }}
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: DaemonSet
metadata:
  name: {{ include "fullname" . }}-prewarm
  annotations:
    prewarm.redwood.com/managed: "true"
...
{{- end }}
"

Review conversation (selected):
- Priya Shah (reviewer): "Thanks — big +1 on the pre-warm idea. Two asks: (1) ensure prewarm RBAC can be limited to the install namespace for locked-down clusters (we shouldn't require cluster-wide permissions by default), and (2) add a knob to control nodeSelector/tolerations so customers can restrict to nodes with extra disk. Otherwise looks good."
- Aisha Khan (author): "Addressed: prewarm RBAC is now namespaced by default and the DaemonSet uses the chart's serviceAccount (namespaced). I added an optional clusterRole binding snippet in comments for operators that intentionally want a cluster-scoped pre-pull daemon (commented in templates/README). Added nodeSelector/tolerations values with examples in values.yaml."
- Diego Mendez (reviewer): "Please add a short note about security implications of pre-warm pulling images in air-gapped clusters — make sure the default behavior remains off. Also ran into a helm-lint whitespace nit."
- Aisha Khan: "Fixed lint nit and added a paragraph in NOTES.txt reiterating default-off and guidance for air-gapped registries (use imageRepository + imagePullSecrets)."

CI and validation notes:
- CI initially failed: helm lint whitespace and a missing comma in values.schema.json example; fixes pushed in second commit.
- After fixes: unit helm template tests pass, kubeval checks pass against k8s v1.27 schema.
- E2E smoke against a kind cluster is marked as flaky for image pulls in CI (infra limits); added a follow-up job to run a prewarm smoke in execution windows (ENG-2198).

Operational considerations and security:
- The pre-warm DaemonSet intentionally runs as a low-priority background workload and is disabled by default. This prevents noisy pre-pulls on shared clusters unless operators opt-in.
- RBAC is namespaced by default; clusterRole-binding snippets are commented and documented for ops that want global pre-warming across multiple namespaces.
- Usage with private registries/air-gapped environments: chart supports imagePullSecrets and a simple tarball pre-seed workflow documented in README (follow-up doc will include an ansible snippet).

Backward compatibility:
- All changes are additive. Default values keep previous behavior. HookProfiles only apply when set by the operator and defer to existing values when unset.

Follow-ups planned:
- ENG-2198: Add optional image pre-cache job that can run from a bastion to pre-seed air-gapped nodes with a tarball (docs and tooling).
- ENG-2201: Add integration test that exercises prewarm on a VM-style cluster (to reduce flaky CI image-pull failures).

Merge outcome:
- Squash-merged by Diego Mendez on 2025-11-10 after approvals from Priya and Luca. CI green at merge time.

If you're reviewing after merge: see README section "onPremPrewarm" for usage examples and NOTES.txt for runbook tips.
